children: Zededa, a leader in edge intelligence, said it has sealed an agreement with VAS Limited, a value-added distributor of global technology solutions, to bring its Edge Intelligence Platform to customers across the kingdom with plans to expand into the wider GCC region.

Deployments across hundreds or thousands of sites are rarely a single product decision. They involve hardware sourcing, multi-vendor integration, on-site commissioning and long-term operational support, all delivered inside the Kingdom.

VAS Limited provides that layer. Zededa provides the platform that deploys, secures and operates applications across the enterprise from one place. The agreement also establishes a joint go-to-market motion, pairing Zededa’s technology with the integration and support practice VAS Limited brings as a value-added distributor.

“This agreement reinforces Zededa’s commitment to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and establishes the foundation for a strategic partnership with VAS Limited in the region,” said Usamah Alridwan, Regional Sales Director and Country Manager, Saudi Arabia, Zededa.

“VAS brings the local reach, technical expertise and customer relationships that edge AI deployments require, and gives us a partner capable of helping organizations deploy edge intelligence at national scale.”

VAS Limited was established in Saudi Arabia in 2024 as the regional office of VAS Integrated Solutions. Its vendor-certified engineering teams span data centers, virtualization, cloud enablement, storage, security and network infrastructure, and its services practice covers the full project lifecycle, from advisory and design through deployment, training and ongoing support.
The company’s focus on developing Saudi technical talent aligns the partnership with the local capability goals set out in Vision 2030.

“Organizations across Saudi Arabia are moving AI closer to where their businesses operate, but doing so at scale requires more than deploying an AI application,” remarked Bilal Abdulrahman, the Country Manager, VAS Limited.

“With Zededa, we can give customers a centralized way to deploy and govern edge applications across distributed locations while delivering the technology and support locally. This is an important capability as Saudi Arabia continues to build the digital infrastructure envisioned by Vision 2030,” he added.
First Joint Solution: Edge AI Video Analytics

The partnership’s initial solution targets edge AI video analytics for branch and remote sites. GPU-accelerated edge appliances ingest camera streams and run AI inference at the point where data is generated, so detection and alerting can continue independently of wide-area network conditions.

Third-party network and security functions, including firewalling and multi-path connectivity across wide-area, local-area and cellular links, can run as virtualised workloads on the same appliance, consolidating what would otherwise be a stack of separate boxes at every location.

The architecture puts local AI decision-making at every site alongside centralized security visibility, policy enforcement and fleet management, with both the workloads and the control plane that governs them remaining inside the Kingdom.
"AI creates value in the physical world only when it can operate reliably across thousands of real sites and under real operating conditions," noted Ernesto Beneke, Vice President EMEAI at Zededa.

"Saudi Arabia is making significant investments in AI and digital infrastructure, and our partnership with VAS Limited brings Zededa’s edge intelligence capabilities directly to the organizations building that future," he added..-
